cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings

cards.example_zh: 冗长的集会进行到一半，男孩们就感到无聊了。

cards.example_zh: 一位勇敢的消防员把孩子从烟雾中抱了出来。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: My younger brother feeds the cat every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我弟弟每天早上给猫喂食。

cards.example_en: Too much sun can burn your skin at the beach.
cards.example_zh: 在海滩上，阳光太强会晒伤你的皮肤。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: The hall has a capacity of five hundred people.
cards.example_zh: 这个大厅的容量是五百人。

家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：舒适；安慰
cards.example_en: A warm blanket and hot tea brought comfort after the cold game.
cards.example_zh: 一场寒冷的比赛之后，暖毯子和热茶带来了安慰。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: At the coach's command, every runner dropped to the track.
cards.example_zh: 教练一声命令，所有选手都趴到了跑道上。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: A quick comparison showed the bus pass costs less than daily tickets.
cards.example_zh: 简单一比较就发现，公交月票比每天买票更便宜。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：应付；处理
cards.example_en: She can cope with a busy week of exams.
cards.example_zh: 她能应付这忙碌的考试周。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: My cousin is coming to stay with us.
cards.example_zh: 我的表弟将入住我们的房源。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: My dad packs an extra bun for me whenever there is a match.
cards.example_zh: 一有比赛，爸爸就会给我多装一个包子。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: Their daughter teaches piano to three children from our street.
cards.example_zh: 他们的女儿教我们这条街上的三个孩子弹钢琴。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: A decade ago this cafeteria was an empty car park.
cards.example_zh: 十年前，这个食堂还是一片空停车场。
